d: Jet black hair is styled in an ornate updo with long, straight bangs framing the face and decorated with red floral ornaments. The eyes are a sharp amber-gold with a calm, focused expression on a youthful, mature face. The build is slender, draped in a traditional layered hanfu consisting of a white inner robe with grey gradient floral patterns, topped by a voluminous deep crimson cloak with thick white fur lining the edges. Signature details include a decorative black rectangular sign held by a white bird and a flowering cherry blossom branch held in one hand.
